label: UniFi U6 Extender
description: A plug-in WiFi 6 mesh extender: no Ethernet port at all, one radio pair (4x4 5 GHz, 2x2 2.4 GHz) and a wall plug. It only reaches the network through a mesh uplink, which is the reason to model it with radios and no copper.
notes: Vendor figures: no networking interface listed - the U6 Extender is a wall-plug mesh unit with no Ethernet port; max data rate 4.8 Gbps on 5 GHz (4x4, BW160) and 573.5 Mbps on 2.4 GHz (2x2, BW40); universal AC input 100-240V AC, 0.3 A max, 11 W max consumption, wall power socket included. Mesh uplink only: in a lab it can join a wireless mesh but cannot be cabled, which is a real constraint of the hardware. No PoE capability is declared (neither poe-pd nor 802.3af): the box has no PD port to negotiate a class on, so an injector cannot power it and a PoE switch has nothing to bill.
